ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Vault Dungeons
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Ash'karr campaign content for the six Forsaken vaults (VAULT_DUNGEON_BUILD_1, design/Jawa/worldbuilding/dungeons_arc_spec.md §3). Ships three parameterized KCSG StructureLayoutDef templates, one per vault type: RUT_VaultType1_MechanoidGarrison (Forgotten Arsenal held, doctrine turrets, materials/weapons-only core loot), RUT_VaultType2_FleshWeaponLoose (breached, bioweapon guardians, no direct loot), RUT_VaultType3_FrozenRakata (dark and inert until the crew feeds a persona core into the vault heart; four Rakata sleepers in real caskets at the core). Each ring is authored per the owner-ruled concentric grammar (outer/garrison/core) and reachable only through its own ring, never skippable in a straight line.
VAULT_THAW_QUEST_FAMILY_1 adds the quest layer (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/vault_thaw_quest_family.md): six RUT_VaultThaw_* QuestScriptDefs gated on Antiquities CARTOGRAPHY (V6 also VOICE) that place each vault as a Site on its ruled fixed tile with the template as map content; RUT_VaultClaimConflict (the woken claim the ship) and RUT_Reclamation (the ruled late-game event, Helix flip included). V6's wake/loot branches listen on signals no vanilla part sends yet - see the design doc's findings. Not yet quicktest-proven.
